plan.title: District Health Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Key health indicators across districts

panels.title: Total children
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Households surveyed") AS n FROM "district_health_factsheet"

panels.title: Average score by site
panels.sql: SELECT "District" AS "site", AVG("Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)") AS "avg_score" FROM "district_health_factsheet" GROUP BY "District" ORDER BY "avg_score" DESC

panels.title: Monthly trend
panels.sql: SELECT "Survey Round" AS "month", SUM("Households surveyed") AS "total" FROM "district_health_factsheet" GROUP BY "Survey Round" ORDER BY "month"

panels.title: Top 10 districts by literacy
panels.sql: SELECT "District", "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS "literacy_percent" FROM "district_health_factsheet" ORDER BY "literacy_percent" DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This dashboard provides a concise overview of district-level health metrics. The KPI shows the total households surveyed across all districts, giving a sense of data coverage. The bar chart ranks districts by average female literacy, highlighting regional disparities. The line chart tracks monthly changes in household survey volume, revealing trends in data collection. Finally, the table lists the top 10 districts by literacy rate, allowing quick identification of high-performing areas.
